name: Graphite Layered Hexagonal Lattice
semanticDescription: Layered planar hexagonal carbon lattice of graphite demonstrating sp2 hexagonal rings within sheets and weak inter-layer van der Waals bonds allowing cleavage and electrical conductivity (CBSE Class 10 Chemistry Ch 4).
simplifications: Two parallel hexagonal sheets depicted to illustrate inter-layer van der Waals spacing.
Bonds within sheets shown as solid covalent rods; interlayer interactions as dashed/thin links.

materials.look: Semi-metallic dark charcoal carbon atom spheres
Planar hexagonal covalent bond connecting rods
Translucent cyan vertical interlayer van der Waals indicator lines
